mapper.select: SELECT i.conversation_id AS conversationId, c.conv_type AS convType, c.group_id AS groupId, g.name AS groupName, CASE WHEN c.conv_type = 'single' AND c.user_a_id = #{userId} THEN c.user_b_id WHEN c.conv_type = 'single' THEN c.user_a_id ELSE NULL END AS peerUserId, pu.username AS peerUsername, pu.nickname AS peerNickname, pu.avatar AS peerAvatar, g.avatar AS groupAvatar, g.notice AS groupNotice, i.unread_count AS unreadCount, i.last_message_id AS lastMessageId, i.last_content AS lastContent, i.last_time AS lastTime, i.pinned AS pinned, i.muted AS muted FROM im_user_inbox i JOIN im_conversation c ON c.id = i.conversation_id LEFT JOIN im_group g ON g.id = c.group_id LEFT JOIN sys_user pu ON pu.id = CASE WHEN c.conv_type = 'single' AND c.user_a_id = #{userId} THEN c.user_b_id WHEN c.conv_type = 'single' THEN c.user_a_id ELSE NULL END WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.pinned DESC, i.last_time DESC NULLS LAST
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_user_inbox (user_id, conversation_id, unread_count, last_read_message_id, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{conversationId}, 0, 0, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, conversation_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: INSERT INTO im_user_inbox (user_id, conversation_id, unread_count, last_read_message_id, last_message_id, last_content, last_time, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{conversationId}, 1, 0, #{message.id}, LEFT(#{preview}, 256), #{message.createdAt}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET unread_count = im_user_inbox.unread_count + 1, last_message_id = EXCLUDED.last_message_id, last_content = EXCLUDED.last_content, last_time = EXCLUDED.last_time, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO im_user_inbox (user_id, conversation_id, unread_count, last_read_message_id, last_message_id, last_content, last_time, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{conversationId}, 0, COALESCE(#{message.id}, 0), #{message.id}, LEFT(#{preview}, 256), #{message.createdAt}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET last_message_id = EXCLUDED.last_message_id, last_content = EXCLUDED.last_content, last_time = EXCLUDED.last_time, updated_at = NOW()
